2653-2893-5455-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1651-2638-5921-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-5921-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-5921-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1418-2226-4443.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-4443.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Riftwing Cloudskate by paying its mana cost.
When Riftwing Cloudskate enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

413-586-678.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

141-4454-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4454-6798.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-1854-2511.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-2511.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-5075-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5075-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Card that Makes a Land Creature with a +1/+1 Counter

1323-4687-4893--205.manaNeeded: {0} plus enough to animate the land
1323-4687-4893--205.easyPrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Gilder Bairn has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a land that can add {G} or {U}.
1323-4687-4893--205.description:
Use any of the listed land animators to turn a land that can produce {G} or {U} into a land creature and put at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using that land's ability by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

586-3899-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7606.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5231-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5231-6351.description:
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

4365-6441-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1367-7417-7638.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Blink Sanar using The Mind Stone. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-7417-7638.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-6965-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

5478-5702-7401.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
5478-5702-7401.notablePrerequisites: At least half of the basic lands in your library are Forests.
5478-5702-7401.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
When the Springbloom Druid token enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a land, then search your library for a basic Forest and another basic land and put them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking 
When the basic lands enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate both lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
Repeat from step 3 until your library contains no basic lands.
5478-5702-7401.notes: You can perform this combo if half the basic lands in your library aren't Forests, but you won't be able to grab all basic lands unless you supplement {G} to compensate. While you will put all basic lands onto the battlefield, you'll have to sacrifice half of them to continue the combo. This won't affect how many landfall triggers, ETB triggers and creature tokens you get however.

1322-2366-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1322-2366-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-5147-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-5147-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

575-1478-5971.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, Yedora triggers, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Sakura-Tribe Elder face-up if its not the first time the ability has resolved this turn, or causing you to manifest dread otherwise.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability from step 1, allowing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers, turning Sakura-Tribe Elder face-up if it is still face-down.
Repeat.

618-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the Kiki-Jiki token by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 2.

1386-1980-2845-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Meldweb Curator.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Meldweb Curator.
When Meldweb Curator enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Meldweb Curator.
Quintorius Kand and Swarm Intelligence trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 3.

307-1807-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Moonsnare Specialist and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Moonsnare Specialist or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
307-1807-2792.description:
Declare Great Whale and Moonsnare Specialist as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Moonsnare Specialist from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moonsnare Specialist's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moonsnare Specialist onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Moonsnare Specialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning up to one target creature from the battlefield to its owner's hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

3129-4499-4685.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Prosperous Pirates.
Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

3504-3821-4115.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
You have no other Shapeshifters on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
3504-3821-4115.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying {4}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a token copy of Mercurial Pretender.
The token Mercurial Pretender enters the battlefield as a copy of Peregrine Drake, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
The nontoken Mercurial Pretender enters the battlefield as a copy of Peregrine Drake, untapping up to five lands.
Activate the nontoken Mercurial Pretender by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-3761-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-3761-4050.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Arcbound Crusher triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Arcbound Crusher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
If desired, you may then sacrifice Arcbound Crusher to Phyrexian Altar to put its +1/+1 counters on any artifact creature you control.
